subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Begins to blend sounds to make words (at, c-at, m-at)

show.line: Blend the sounds! c, a, t. Cat! s, i, t. Sit! Listen and blend.

rounds.prompt: Listen. c, a, t. What word is it?
Listen. p, i, n. Tap the word.
s, i, t. Blend the sounds. What word is it?
Listen. t, i, n. What word is it?
d, a, d. Blend the sounds. Who is it?
Does the word end in at, or in in? Sort the words.

hints: Say the sounds slowly, then fast. c, a, t. Cat!

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! m, a, t is mat. Cat starts with c.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's blend together. Mmm, a, t. Mat!

parent_line: Can blend three sounds into words like cat, pin and sit.
